title: PHP Backend Developer
description:
Join the dynamic team at Appentus Technology as a PHP Backend Developer, where your skills can truly shine! We're a lively company nestled in the ever-evolving world of Technology, Information, and Internet industries. With a team of 51-200 talented individuals, we pride ourselves on fostering innovation and creativity in everything we do. As a PHP Backend Developer, you'll dive into exciting projects, working alongside passionate professionals who are eager to push boundaries and explore new tech frontiers. If you're someone who thrives in a collaborative environment and loves tackling complex challenges with innovative solutions, this is the perfect place for you. Get ready to make a real impact and grow your career with us. We can't wait to see what you bring to our team!

**Tasks**
---------

* Maintain and monitor the NPO web application
* Ensure smooth functioning and performance of the website
* Analyze business requirements and implement new features
* Design system architecture for enhancements
* Coordinate with development team for implementation
* Perform routine checks and troubleshoot issues
* Manage and update database tables regularly
* Validate data and ensure accuracy in reports
* Generate and upload PDF reports
* Support deployment and server-side operations
* Handle data processing and reporting tasks
* Communicate with stakeholders for requirement understanding

**Requirements**
----------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/IT or related field
* Experience in Core PHP development
* Strong knowledge of MySQL/Oracle databases
* Familiarity with Apache/Nginx servers
* Experience with XAMPP/LAMP stack
* Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript
* Hands-on experience with phpMyAdmin
* Knowledge of FTP tools like FileZilla
* Good problem-solving and analytical skills
* Strong attention to detail
* Good communication and teamwork skills

**Benefits**
------------

**Benefits:**  
Competitive salary based on experience

Opportunity to work on diverse and exciting projects

Collaborative and growth-oriented work environmen

Career advancement and skill development opportunities

Modern office space located in Jaipur

Join Appentus Technology as a PHP Backend Developer! Be part of a dynamic tech team, innovate in the internet space, and grow with us. Exciting challenges await you!
